verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch explicitly markets team collaboration ('Helps you collaborate across your teams to design, develop, and test APIs faster') and collections/folders with shared headers/auth, and a hands-on HN reviewer confirms 'made saving and sharing collections super easy.' However, other hands-on community reports note real limitations to shared/synced workspaces (only one workspace available offline, self-hosting login not possible in desktop app, no git-friendly sync), suggesting the synced shared-workspace experience is imperfect. Missing for 10: first-party documentation detailing team/workspace sync mechanics, and independent confirmation that sync works reliably across members/devices without the noted gaps.
